page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.se1.2xlarge is characterized by weak single-core and multi-core CPU capabilities, placing in the bottom 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench tests. Memory bandwidth for large uncached blocks is average, though small-block cached read bandwidth is weak. Cryptographic and compression tasks show poor performance, with single-threaded gzip and bzip3 decompression falling into the bottom 10%. However, the instance achieves average results in Redis SET operations and small-model LLM inference prompt processing.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is its high memory capacity paired with relatively weak compute performance. From a cost-efficiency perspective, it provides a dense memory profile without the premium cost of high-performance compute cores. This makes the ecs.se1.2xlarge suitable for memory-intensive workloads that do not require intensive CPU processing, such as caching layers, medium-sized databases, and memory-bound general-purpose applications.
